items.t: Said American houses are for American people.
items.q: Here in America, we prioritize American people and American people only. American houses are for American people

items.t: Said housing assistance was never meant to trap work-able people on government support, and that a paycheck is empowering while a welfare check is not.
items.q: Housing assistance was never meant to trap work-able individuals on government support their entire lives

items.t: Said homelessness programs should measure success by how many people achieve long-term self-sufficiency, not dollars spent.
items.q: Our philosophy for addressing the homelessness crisis will now define success not by dollars spent or housing units filled, but by how many people achieve long-term self-sufficiency and recovery

items.t: Served as Executive Director of the White House Opportunity and Revitalization Council and, during his tenure, led the interagency Opportunity Zones Initiative to revitalize economically distressed areas and promote affordable housing.
items.q: He previously served as Executive Director of the White House Opportunity and Revitalization Council (WHORC). During his tenure, Turner led the interagency Opportunity Zones Initiative working with state, local, tribal, and territorial governments across the country to revitalize economically distressed areas, promote affordable housing, and the creation of new businesses.

items.t: Said God created two sexes, male and female, and that gender ideology would no longer take precedence over the safety of vulnerable women.
items.q: God created two sexes: male and female. The Left’s war on biological reality through radical gender ideology will no longer take precedence over the safety and security of America’s most vulnerable women

items.t: Said HUD was preventing illegal immigrants and non-residents from accessing taxpayer-backed FHA loan programs.
items.q: We are preventing illegals and non-residents from accessing taxpayer-backed programs at the expense of American homebuyers.

items.t: Said illegal aliens would no longer be able to take advantage of HUD-funded housing.
items.q: No longer will illegal aliens be able to leave citizenship boxes blank or take advantage of HUD-funded housing, riding the coattails of hardworking American citizens

record.q: Secretary Turner took action to make housing more affordable by rescinding burdensome guidance that made building, buying, and renting a home more expensive.

record.office: Secretary of Housing and Urban Development
record.t: Announced $3.9 billion in Continuum of Care homelessness grants under reforms he said would end a "Biden-era slush fund."
record.q: Secretary Scott Turner announced $3.9 billion in competitive grant funding through HUD’s FY 2025 Continuum of Care (CoC) Competition Notice of Funding Opportunity (NOFO).

record.office: Secretary of Housing and Urban Development
record.t: Ordered a nationwide review of public housing to find residents in the country illegally, giving each public housing authority 30 days to audit.
record.q: Turner wrote that each public housing authority has 30 days to conduct an audit to ensure that the existing orders are enforced.

record.office: Secretary of Housing and Urban Development
record.t: Announced $2.2 million in new funding for the Tribal HUD-VASH rental assistance program for Native American veterans.
record.q: Secretary Scott Turner today announced $2.2 million in new available funding under the Tribal HUD-Veterans Affairs Supportive Housing (VASH) program.

record.q: Secretary Turner was confirmed by a bipartisan vote of 55-44 and sworn in by Associate Justice of the United States Supreme Court, the Honorable Clarence Thomas.
